voice_lines: At today's Delhi prices, petrol costs about six rupees forty a kilometre, diesel about four eighty, CNG about three twenty, and an EV charged at home about one ten.
But diesel, CNG and EVs cost more to buy, so the savings only come with kilometres.
Under a thousand kilometres a month, petrol is fine. One to two thousand, look at CNG or a hybrid. Lots of kilometres and home charging, an EV.
Do the maths with your own kilometres and your city's prices. Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
Which fuel costs least per km? ⛽⚡

Delhi prices on 7 Nov 2026 (your city's prices will differ):
• Petrol: about ₹6.4/km (₹102/l at 16 km/l)
• Diesel: about ₹4.8/km (₹95/l at 20 km/l)
• CNG: about ₹3.2/km (₹83/kg at 26 km/kg)
• EV at home: about ₹1.1/km (₹8/unit at 7 km/unit)

But diesel, CNG and EVs cost more to buy, so the savings need kilometres.

Under 1,000 km/month: petrol is fine. 1,000-2,000: CNG or hybrid. Lots of km + home charging: EV.

What's your monthly km? Tell me and I'll tell you what I'd pick 👇
